items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: I think I saw my first jazz funeral when the man who rode last Friday down, oh, drive down, Paul Barberant. When Paul Barberant died.

ctx.x: Do you have any street parades? I mean, just.

Yeah, well, that's the only thing that I saw, street brass bands around Carnival time, you know. But I think I saw my first jazz funeral when the man who rode last Friday down, oh, drive down, Paul Barberant.
